eligibility_note: Exclusion E4 is correct. Section 5.1 says real data collection (WDI, ITU, UNDP, OECD, WGI) 'has not yet been completed' and that every coefficient in Tables 2-7 comes from a 'calibrated synthetic panel: a simulated country-year dataset'. Section 9 ('Data Architecture') is future tense, and Section 8 says the real data will be assembled later. The paper does no estimation on observed World Bank or other real data, so it fails the own-empirical-estimation criterion.
